analysis: MP-0 vs OFF23 direct force comparison on rMD17 aspirin (model-vs-model, not vs ref)
convention: component-wise over all structs*atoms*xyz; meV/A; delta = F_MP - F_OFF

sanity_vs_ref.note: should reproduce the verdict JSONs (MP 337.5 / OFF 447.2)

hypothesis_check.question: Is RMSE(F_MP - F_OFF) close to 447-337 ~ 110 meV/A?
hypothesis_check.interpretation: RMSE(delta)=511.7 meV/A is NOT close to the naive 447-337=109.6. RMSEs don't subtract linearly: the collinear limit is 109.6, the orthogonal-extra limit sqrt(off^2-mp^2)=293.3, the independent limit sqrt(mp^2+off^2)=560.2. Actual is closest to '~sqrt(mp^2+off^2) (errors independent, r_e=0)'. Error correlation r(e_MP,e_OFF)=0.172, raw-force correlation r(F_MP,F_OFF)=0.923. The MP-OFF force difference (512 meV/A, ~40% of the 1264 meV/A force scale) is a real, structured PBE-vs-wB97M-D3 difference, not a small clean offset.
